context: A teacher and a student discuss a documentary
purpose: Teach: 分布/良心/防御/加害/捜索/河川/大震災/楽観

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨夜のドキュメンタリー、地震被害の分布、印象的でしたね。
lines.en: That documentary last night — the way they mapped the quake damage was really striking.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Warm opening on the observation, inviting response. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 河川沿いの避難所、防御施設が古くて。
lines.en: The shelters along the river, though — their defenses were so outdated.
lines.style: Quiet concern beneath the surface. Shifts slightly in seat. Not accusatory, but clearly troubled by what she saw. Slight hesitation on 'defenses' as if the inadequacy still bothers her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 行政の良心、問われる場面でしたね。
lines.en: It really put the government's responsibility under a microscope, didn't it.
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. Not lecturing — noticing aloud. Gentle weight on 'responsibility.' Looking at Sakura to see if she's tracking the implication.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 加害責任の追及、楽観視できない論点が多いです。
lines.en: And the accountability questions — there are so many angles you can't just brush past.
lines.style: Lean into the intellectual weight here. Serious, penetrating tone. No rushed delivery. Acknowledges the complexity without backing away from it. Slight emphasis on 'can't just brush past.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災地での捜索活動、ボランティアの貢献も大きい。
lines.en: But what struck me too was how much the volunteers were doing in those affected areas. Their work really mattered.
lines.style: Warm shift in tone — not dismissing the hard questions, but brightening the frame. Genuinely moved by this part. Slower pace, like she's holding onto this image. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大震災から学ぶこと、まだまだあります。
lines.en: There's still so much we can learn from what happened.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Gentle but clear conviction. Finishes with slight lift — not optimistic exactly, but acknowledging possibility. Spare, direct delivery. Leaves space for Sakura.
